## Who I Am
  I’m a software engineer who values clean code, workflow efficiency, and clear documentation. I’m also an educator who enjoys sharing my knowledge of computer engineering and movement, two disciplines that bring me joy in different ways. I find satisfaction in lifting others up and leaving every space I occupy better than I found it. My favorite things are coding, handstands, and rabbits 🐰
